_what_this_is: The REQUIRED status contexts on this repo's default branch, as read back from the GitHub branch-protection API. Committed as a fixture because the floor tier is stdlib-only and offline: it cannot call the API. Consumed by tests/test_ci_enforcement_floor.py (INV-3, INV-5).
_why_it_exists: INV-3 used to credit ANY workflow that triggers on master. That conflates 'a gate that CAN run' with 'a gate that IS required' — the exact distinction PR #15 argued for in prose and then failed to encode. Re-adding --ignore=tests/test_smoke_e2e.py to the REQUIRED unit-tests job still passed INV-3, because the non-required smoke-test.yml got the credit. Only a context in this file can make a test file 'covered'.
_staleness_contract: This file is a CLAIM about a mutable remote setting. It goes out of date silently, so it carries its own expiry: observed_at + max_age_days. Past that, INV-3 and INV-5 fail as NOT-OBSERVED (never pass) until someone re-runs refresh_command and updates observed_at. A stale fixture must not be able to certify anything.

_not_required_but_triggers_on_master.smoke-test.yml / MCP server end-to-end s: runs pytest tests/test_smoke_e2e.py and DOES trigger on push+pull_request to master since 6c3ec67, but it is NOT in required_checks. It therefore credits NOTHING in INV-3. This is the entry that made Codex's probe pass.
_not_required_but_triggers_on_master.security_scan.yml / bandit, dependency-a: also triggers on master, also not required, also credits nothing.

_caveats_not_waived.enforce_admins_false: An admin can push straight to master and bypass all five contexts. INV-3/INV-5 certify what gates an ORDINARY PR; they do not certify that master cannot be written past.
_caveats_not_waived.no_required_reviews: required_pull_request_reviews is null on master. Status checks are the only gate.
_caveats_not_waived.app_id_not_verified_per_run: app_id is recorded from the protection payload so INV-5 can tell a GitHub-Actions context (must be produced by a job in this repo) from an external app's context (Aikido, app_id 898896 — produced outside the workflow tree and therefore exempt). INV-5 does not verify that the external app actually posts.
